## Calisthenics Awakening

**Android:** download the `.apk` below, open it on your phone and allow "Install unknown apps" when asked.

**iPhone:** the `-unsigned.ipa` must be signed before it installs. The free way is [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io) with your own Apple ID (the app then runs for 7 days before you re-sign it). See the README for details.

### New in v0.3.0
- Clean black and lime look with a new font, fewer words and bigger numbers
- Skill tree is now a smooth Duolingo-style path instead of the laggy map
- New Home: profile header, stats, week cards, streak trophy and a daily chest
- Arc timer for the warm-up and a weight ruler in Diet
- Light mode still in Settings

### What's inside
- Daily goals you tick off for EXP, with a daily chest and streaks
- Skill tree: 22 skills across Push, Pull and Core & Legs, from your first push-up to Planche, Front Lever and Human Flag
- EXP, levels and ranks from E to S
- 5 minute guided warm-up with timer
- Diet plan built from your height, weight, age, sex, goal and activity
